description: Java source code for AccountsApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing share accounts in the Fineract platform, including templates, retrieval, creation, updates, commands, and bulk import functionalities.

classes.name: AccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for share account operations in Fineract.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a share account template with default values and allowed options.

methods.name: retrieveAccount
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific share account by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllAccounts
methods.description: Lists all share accounts with optional pagination.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Submits a new share account application.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Performs various commands on a share account such as approve, reject, activate, close, redeem, etc.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Modifies an existing share account application.

methods.name: getSharedAccountsTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of share accounts.

methods.name: postSharedAccountsTemplate
methods.description: Uploads an Excel file to bulk import share accounts.
